## 第 1 条SQL

```sql
-- 步骤1：查询所有已装箱发货单对应的发货任务记录，统计每个待发明细的累计发货量（不关注员工身份信息） WITH shipped AS ( SELECT atd.awaiting_details_code, SUM(COALESCE(atd.this_count, 0)) AS shipped_total FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_task_details_9 atd INNER JOIN dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_invoice_order_9 io ON io.primary_key = atd.invoice_order WHERE atd.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 AND atd.delete_flag = false AND io.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 AND io.delete_flag = false AND io.packaged = true GROUP BY atd.awaiting_details_code ) -- 步骤2：关联待发明细表，按产品分组统计总累计发货量和总需发货量 SELECT ad.product_code AS productCode, ad.product_name AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(sh.shipped_total), 0) AS shippedTotal, SUM(COALESCE(ad.product_quantity, 0)) AS quantityTotal FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_details_9 ad LEFT JOIN shipped sh ON sh.awaiting_details_code = ad.primary_key WHERE ad.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 AND ad.delete_flag = 'f' AND ad.product_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ad.product_code, ad.product_name
```

## 第 15 条SQL

```sql
-- 步骤1：查询当前年范围内所有已装箱发货单对应的发货任务记录，统计每个待发明细的累计发货量 -- 参考 AwaitingGoodsServiceImpl.awaitingGoodsPageList() 方法，使用 invoiceOrder.create_time 作为时间过滤字段 WITH shipped AS ( SELECT atd.awaiting_details_code, SUM(COALESCE(atd.this_count, 0)) AS shipped_total FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_task_details_9 atd INNER JOIN dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_invoice_order_9 io ON io.primary_key = atd.invoice_order WHERE atd.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 AND atd.delete_flag = false AND io.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 AND io.delete_flag = false AND io.packaged = true AND io.create_time IS NOT NULL AND io.create_time >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00.0' AND io.create_time <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59.0' GROUP BY atd.awaiting_details_code ), -- 步骤2：查询当前年范围内已签约的销售合同对应的待发明细（用于统计需发货量） -- 对于在当前年范围内已经签约过的销售合同订单（state IN ('MUTUAL_SIGN', 'UNILATERAL_SIGN', 'SEALED')）内的产品， -- 即使没有发货记录，也需要添加到统计需发货产品数量 signedContracts AS ( SELECT sc.primary_key AS contract_code FROM dm_m9.sell_t_dm_m9_sell_contract_9 sc WHERE sc.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 AND sc.delete_flag = 'f' AND sc.state IN ('MUTUAL_SIGN', 'UNILATERAL_SIGN', 'SEALED') AND sc.contract_time IS NOT NULL AND sc.contract_time >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00.0' AND sc.contract_time <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59.0' ) -- 步骤3：统计当前年时间段内总累计发货量和总需发货量 -- 已发货数量：统计有发货记录的产品 -- 需发货数量：统计所有在当前年范围内已签约的销售合同订单内的产品，不管是否有发货记录 SELECT NULL AS productCode, NULL AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(sh.shipped_total), 0) AS shippedTotal, SUM(COALESCE(ad.product_quantity, 0)) AS quantityTotal FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_details_9 ad INNER JOIN signedContracts sc ON sc.contract_code = ad.contract_code LEFT JOIN shipped sh ON sh.awaiting_details_code = ad.primary_key WHERE ad.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 AND ad.delete_flag = 'f'
```

## 第 45 条SQL

```sql
WITH contract_receiving_summary AS ( -- 按订单编号汇总产品总数量和已收货数量 SELECT pc.contract_number AS "contractNumber", -- 该订单下的产品总数量：汇总该订单下所有收货明细的 contract_quantity COALESCE(SUM(srd.contract_quantity), 0) AS "totalQuantity", -- 已收货总数量：汇总该订单下所有收货记录的 receive COALESCE(SUM(sr.receive), 0) AS "totalReceived" FROM dm_m9.purchase_t_dm_m9_purchase_contract_9 pc -- 关联收货明细表，获取产品数量 INNER JOIN dm_m9.purchase_t_dm_m9_self_receiving_detail_9 srd ON pc.primary_key = srd.purchase_contract AND srd.delete_flag = false -- 关联收货记录表，获取已收货数量 LEFT JOIN dm_m9.purchase_t_dm_m9_self_receiving_record_9 sr ON sr.self_receiving_detail_code = srd.primary_key AND sr.delete_flag = false WHERE pc.delete_flag = false AND pc.enterprise_code = 190787210592256000 -- 按订单编号分组 GROUP BY pc.contract_number ) SELECT -- 订单编号 -- 注意：引用 CTE 中的字段别名时，必须使用双引号保持大小写一致 crs."contractNumber" AS "contractNumber", -- 该订单下的产品总数量 crs."totalQuantity" AS "totalQuantity", -- 已收百分比：已收货总数量 / 该订单下的产品总数量 CASE WHEN crs."totalQuantity" > 0 THEN ROUND((crs."totalReceived"::numeric / crs."totalQuantity"::numeric * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS "receivedPercent", -- 未收百分比：100% - 已收百分比 CASE WHEN crs."totalQuantity" > 0 THEN ROUND((100 - (crs."totalReceived"::numeric / crs."totalQuantity"::numeric * 100))::numeric, 2) ELSE 100 END AS "unreceivedPercent" FROM contract_receiving_summary crs -- 按订单编号排序 ORDER BY crs."contractNumber"
```

### 执行错误

```
LINE 1: ..._summary crs -- 按订单编号排序 ORDER BY crs."contractNumber"
                                                                       ^

```
